name: Golden Gate 2: Goddess Heart
description:
Golden Gate 2: Goddess Heart is a modification for Gothic II: Gold Edition. The mod offers a deep, multi-threaded story with numerous choices that influence gameplay, enhanced systems and mechanics, full Polish voice acting, a completely new original soundtrack, and a beautifully original open world.

 

 

MOD FEATURES
● A brand-new area – one of the islands of the Kingdom of Elea, filled with secrets to
uncover
● Deep story with many impactful choices
● Over 70 non-linear quests
● Full high-quality Polish voice acting
● Around 30 hours of gameplay
● Vivid characters that evolve and deepen as you interact with them
● Atmospheric original soundtrack (over 20 tracks)
● A wealth of new animations, models, and textures
● Balanced economy, difficulty, and learning system
● Multi-phase and complex boss fights
● New mechanics and scripting solutions
● Many new armors and weapons
● Unique environmental and logic riddles
● Two extensive romance subplots
● New cutscenes

 

 

WORLD

We will take you on an unforgettable adventure to a brand-new part of the Gothic world – the Kingdom of Elea. Travel across its part, the Island of Samoa, which years ago was inhabited by a bloodlusting cult of the Hasisians and still hides their dark secrets. You can expect many unique locations such as a port town, hunter, lumberjack, and bandit camps, swamps, dead lands, a winter biome, as well as many underground locations.

 

 

STORY

The main character is Morris, a young hunter. He lives on Samoa his whole life, which has a significant influence on gameplay. Most characters already know Morris and have a specific opinion of him. Of course, as a consequence of your action, you will be able to shape those opinions anew. You can improve Morris's relationships with people or antagonize them. Your choices matter, and you cannot please everyone!

 

 

Morris's main goal is to discover his descent. To do that, he must leave the island, but it will not be so simple, as fate is a cruel mistress, and she will set many obstacles right before him...

The hero will be tangled in the intrigue with far higher stakes than he would ever imagine. Your choices will shape the destiny of the island, and maybe even of the whole Kingdom...
